protocol.target: any true cell temperature >=70 C in next 60 seconds
protocol.training: none; fixed trailing 30-second ordinary least squares
protocol.holdout: new seeds; existing fault families, no real-world or unseen-family claim

limitations: Windows within an episode overlap and are correlated; no independent-window CI claimed.
Lead times summarize true-positive windows, not independent incident detection.
Target is future thermal crossing, not fault identity or pre-onset fault prediction.
Synthetic seeds held out; known fault families, no real-plant calibration.
No parameters fitted or tuned on these results; protocol and source hashes retained.
